description: Independent static preservation of the Parkjets RC aircraft plan catalogue.

planAcquisition.target: Archive a validated local copy of the plan file for every aircraft
planAcquisition.method: Plan files were NOT retrieved from Parkjets. The authorised MemberSpace account is behind a paid membership ($24.99/yr or $5 one-time) and the archive does not circumvent a paywall. The maintainer supplied their own paid-membership downloads from a local folder; those files were matched to aircraft by exact original filename from the Parkjets catalogue, validated, hashed, and copied in.
planAcquisition.verifiedBy: scripts: validate-aircraft, validate-files, audit, and an independent filesystem re-hash of all 109 files

priorCompletionClaim.note: Retained for audit. This earlier claim was NOT valid: it counted 109 source URLs as plan archival. It was corrected, and this completion is backed by 109 validated files on disk with recorded SHA-256 digests.
